items.t: Clutch pedal sticks to the floor
items.job: Replace concentric clutch slave cylinder (transmission removal) and bleed
items.note: Owners report about $1,050-1,900, more if the clutch and flywheel are replaced at the same time.

items.t: Manual gearbox grinds going into gear
items.job: Rebuild or replace 6-speed manual transmission
items.note: Owners report $2,900-3,000 for synchro repairs or a replacement gearbox.

items.t: Excessive oil consumption on 2005-2006 manual cars
items.job: Replace short engine block
items.note: Nissan replaced engines that failed its oil consumption test while under warranty.

items.t: Oil gallery gasket failure
items.job: Replace oil gallery gaskets behind the timing cover
items.note: 8020 Automotive puts the total at about $1,600-3,500 depending on the shop.

items.t: Crank or cam sensor can stall the engine (recall)
items.job: Replace crank and cam position sensors (recall)

items.t: Camshaft position sensor failure
items.job: Replace camshaft position sensors

items.t: Fuel filler hose can crack and leak (recall)
items.job: Replace fuel filler hose (recall)

items.t: Timing chain rattle on cold start
items.job: Replace timing chain guides and tensioners

items.t: Ticking or knocking at idle from the fuel line
items.job: Install revised fuel damper and hose

items.t: Power window stops working or won't close fully
items.job: Replace power window motor and regulator

items.t: Worn front compression rod bushings
items.job: Replace front compression rods or bushings and align

items.t: Tires wear out quickly on the inner edges
items.job: Four-wheel alignment and two new tires
items.note: CarComplaints lists a typical $1,000 cost when owners replace tires repeatedly.

items.t: Clicking from the rear axles when pulling away
items.job: Clean and grease rear driveshaft flange per bulletin

items.t: Passenger airbag may be switched off by mistake (recall)
items.job: Test and replace occupant sensor (recall)

items.t: Steering lock fails and the car won't start
items.job: Replace electronic steering column lock unit
items.note: Many 2009-2010 cars were covered by free service campaign P3208. CarComplaints owners report about $1,000-1,900 when paying themselves.

items.t: Power window may not reverse when it hits something (recall)
items.job: Replace power window switch (recall)

items.t: Driver curtain airbag may be installed wrong (recall)
items.job: Inspect and correct curtain airbag installation (recall)

items.t: Clogged or rattling catalytic converters
items.job: Replace catalytic converter
items.note: RepairPal estimates about $2,440-2,519 for a catalytic converter replacement on the 350Z.

items.t: Water pump leaks or fails
items.job: Replace water pump and coolant

items.t: Rear hatch won't pop up or stay open
items.job: Replace both hatch gas struts

items.t: Soft clutch pedal from a leaking master cylinder
items.job: Replace clutch master cylinder and bleed
items.note: RepairPal estimates about $452-526 for a clutch master cylinder on the 370Z.

items.t: A/C compressor or condenser failure
items.job: Replace A/C compressor or condenser and recharge
items.note: Owners report about $1,200-1,250 for these repairs.

items.t: Convertible top tears or top motor fails
items.job: Replace convertible top fabric or top motor

items.t: Rear differential whine or clunk
items.job: Replace differential bushings or rebuild ring and pinion

items.t: Car may roll away in Park (recall)
items.job: Reprogram transmission computer (recall)

items.t: Pop-up hood may not lift in a crash (recall)
items.job: Tighten bumper reinforcement fasteners (recall)

items.t: Pedestrian sensor wiring may be reversed (recall)
items.job: Replace front bumper harness (recall)

items.t: Notchy shifting or grinding in the 6-speed manual
items.job: Inspect shifter and transmission under warranty
items.note: These cars are young enough that most repairs fall under Nissan's powertrain warranty.

items.t: Check engine light with mass airflow codes
items.job: Diagnose and repair per Nissan bulletin

items.t: Key not detected and engine won't start
items.job: Replace key fob battery or diagnose key system
